a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of reaching 8 first needs two storm-free rounds, about a 4% chance, so it almost certainly leaves both of us dead. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than quietly break our deal later. If you have a plan that gives us both a real chance, tell me and I'll reconsider.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. The storm odds made waiting for 8 close to a death sentence for both of us. If we get more rounds, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4 as well.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
